claims.result: The supplied positive weighted stick-breaking Jacobi/cyclotomic design exactly matches the t=m+1 projective moment and every lower required moment.
The occupation splitter is an isometry on each entire sector; sector pinching plus bottom replacement is CPTP on all B(H); displayed marginal half trace error is exactly 1/L.
e >= 1 - average_j (N_j+1)/(N_j+d), with arbitrary mixed prepared states and global cross-sector measurements.
(d-1)/[2L(d+1)] <= b2 <= 1/L; exact optimum of the ladder is not claimed.
Exact max-prior C = average_j ln binom(N_j+d-1,N_j).
Separate exact entropy formula with a=(1-eta)/L,s=eta/D_tot; maximum attained by the same finite design. C'/C ->1 for eta=L^-3.
Original and faithful radii both have order C for d=L2^(L-1); exact radius is not claimed.
Uniform-prior accessible information <=a^2/(d+1), but max-prior accessible and Holevo capacities both equal h(a).
e=a d/[2(d+1)] and b2=a d/[4(d+1)]=e/2 exactly; no small-b counterexample results from the uniform-prior locking bound.
Finite faithful experiments can have b2->0 and e->1 with exploding complexity; no unrestricted dimension-independent modulus e<=g(b2),g(b)->0.
This family does not establish a capacity-matching exponential lower example, a universal power law, or the improved logarithmic modulus.
C4, compatible smoother, tracial rate and general observational-radius transfer were not inspected.
